question: Can a jointly trained multimodal persistent computational chain carry cross-modal information into later queries, selectively address persistent state, execute a learned operator choice, verify the post-action outcome, and remain capable on held-out modality/operator/query compositions?

information_flow.pre_action: text,image,audio -> encoders -> shared representation -> persistent write -> query-conditioned read -> operator selection -> action
information_flow.post_action: environment outcome -> verifier -> differentiable write gate -> persistent state update

controls.no_memory: zero all persistent values before query
controls.shuffle_one_modality: permute image observations across entities while leaving text/audio aligned
controls.unimodal: zero two of the three modality streams
controls.heldout_composition: evaluation query tuples are absent from training query tuples

scientific_boundaries: Synthetic multimodal evidence is a mechanism benchmark, not real-world semantic multimodal capability.
Finite training/evaluation results do not establish scaling laws.
Auxiliary representation losses are training scaffolds and are not available at inference.
The verifier receives post-action environment feedback; it must not be interpreted as a pre-action oracle.
The first phase does not claim that end-to-end learning makes every component necessary; necessity is tested by ablation.

amendments.reason: Align preregistered secondary endpoints and paired-control evaluation with the authoritative runner before any confirmatory measurement.
changes: remove modality_reconstruction_loss from the secondary endpoint list
evaluate normal and all controls on the same held-out episodes per seed

amendments.reason: Remove a registered query-noise parameter that is not implemented by the benchmark generator.
Strengthen multimodal identifiability and close two benchmark leakage/shortcut paths before confirmatory execution.
changes: change latent state from 8 to 12 bits
assign bits 0-3 to text, 4-7 to image, and 8-11 to audio so no single modality contains the full payload
restrict training/evaluation index pairs to canonical i<j because Boolean operators are commutative
make q1 and q2 target different observed entities so q1 outcome cannot directly supply q2's target state

amendments.reason: Make the trivial operator-prior baseline and seed uncertainty mandatory outputs.
changes: add deterministic seed bootstrap with fixed resample count and seed
report bootstrap intervals for primary q2 accuracy and paired control drops

amendments.reason: Align persistent state transition semantics with the intended PLM chain.
changes: post-action verified feedback writes only to the entity whose action was executed
verifier output continues to control write strength
prevent q1 feedback from changing another entity's persistent slot

amendments.reason: Correct verifier semantics so the verifier predicts environment success from pre-verification evidence and the environment outcome is the sole correctness target.
changes: verifier input excludes the outcome label
verifier target is the observed environment success outcome
only successful outcomes can create or modify authoritative persistent state
verifier controls write strength after the success gate
